items.title: New England January Natural Gas Premiums Defy Broader US Winter Outlook
items.summary: New England natural gas forwards are topping $20/MMBtu for January 2027 at several key hubs, even as Henry Hub trades below $4 and expectations for ample US supplies point to a relatively comfortable winter market.

items.summary: A slightly bearish government storage surprise tempered bullish sentiment in the natural gas futures market, ending a four-day run of gains for the prompt month on Thursday.

items.title: Storage Surprise Sends Natural Gas Futures Sliding Toward $3.10
items.summary: US natural gas futures extended their losses Thursday after a larger-than-expected government storage injection, sending the November contract toward $3.100/MMBtu despite subdued domestic production and hurricane-related offshore supply disruptions.

items.title: Manufacturing Growth Set to Lift US Industrial Natural Gas Demand
items.summary: US industrial natural gas consumption is poised to accelerate in 2027 as stronger manufacturing activity boosts demand from gas-intensive industries, including the chemicals sector, according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).
